section.title: Session history search
section.subtitle: Search across sessions: Chinese is split into neighbouring pairs, so one or two characters still hit
field.indexFile.label: Index file
field.indexFile.help: A side cache: deleting it only makes the next search backfill again, and not a byte of session history is touched.
field.indexDir.label: Index directory
field.indexDir.help: The index file is {file} under this directory; pointing it elsewhere rebuilds the whole table once.
field.includeArchived.label: Index archived sessions too
field.includeArchived.help: While off, the archive (sessions/.archived) is not indexed and cannot be found by search; turn it on and one backfill makes it searchable.
field.includeHiddenDirs.label: Include the trash and teammate logs
field.includeHiddenDirs.help: The trash (.trash, cleared after 30 days) and teammate logs (.teammates) are not indexed by default, so a subagent's run records do not turn up either.
field.maxFileBytes.label: Size limit per session file (bytes)
field.maxFileBytes.help: A session past the limit only has its mtime and size recorded, with no parsing of its body; it is tried again once the content changes.
field.snippetLength.label: Snippet length (characters)
field.snippetLength.help: The snippet is cut around the first hit; too long and it crowds the context out.
field.backfillBatch.label: Session files per batch
field.backfillBatch.help: The event loop is yielded between batches: a larger number backfills faster, and the host stutters more while it runs.
field.defaultLimit.label: Hits returned per search
field.defaultLimit.help: Used when the tool and /search do not ask for a count themselves.
field.indexState.label: Index state
field.indexState.never: {files} session files · {terms} terms · not written yet
field.rebuild.label: Rebuild the index
field.rebuild.help: Throws the whole index away and backfills again: click it after moving the index directory or when the index looks stale; progress goes to the session stream.
save.indexDirEmpty: The index directory cannot be empty.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.unknownName: This section has no such button: {name}
action.rebuildStarted: The index is rebuilding in the background; search results are fresh once it finishes
